title: Set
description: Copies the source payload (whole trees included) into the destination when the source is fresh, or writes a constant when the source is unwired. Types and counts must match.
activation: Runs when the source (input 0) is fresh, or on each pass an enable fires (an open gate, a tick), and the block is enabled. With no source it writes its constant when an enable fires (once at start without enables).

source.title: Source
source.description: The object to copy. Leave it unwired to write the Value constant instead.
